notes.title: Update Announcement: Psychopath Massacre - Run for Your Life!
notes.content:
Greetings!

I am thrilled to present a fantastic upgrade for Psychopath Massacre that will alter your terror experience. Your feedback has helped shape these enhancements, and I can't wait for you to try them out!

Key Features in This Update:

🧠 Enhanced Enemy AI: 
Our psychopath has been upgraded with smarter AI, making your escape more challenging and heart-pounding than ever. He’s more unpredictable, so stay sharp!

🔪 Weapon Change: 
The shotgun is gone. Say hello to the meat cleaver! This change ensures you have a fair chance to escape without being unfairly taken down from a distance. Run, dodge, and survive!

🚪 New Escape Mechanics: 
Hiding spots are a thing of the past. Now, it’s all about outrunning the psychopath. You’re faster than him, but be strategic! You can still take cover in the garage passage and laundry room passage if you need a breather.

🔧 Visual Fixes: 
We’ve addressed the annoying visual glitch where objects disappeared in the distance. Your environment will now stay consistent, keeping you immersed in the horror.

🖥️ Performance Boost: 
We’ve improved the framerate slightly, ensuring a smoother experience. We still recommend playing on a mid-range computer for the best performance.

https://i.imgur.com/aB6pjkJ.gif

Plans for the next update:

🔫 Player be able to shoot & stun the psychopath.

I won't be able to update the game for a long because I have final exams, but after I'm done, I'll make some fantastic updates.

Prepare yourself for a challenging encounter in which every decision is critical and survival is not guaranteed. Update your game right now and see if you have what it takes to escape the hands of the psychopath!

Stay vigilant, stay alive,
Galactic Crows team!
